title: [ZPA] icmp_access_type missing from application segment create/update tools

blocks.heading: [ZPA] icmp_access_type missing from application segment create/update tools

blocks.text: The ZPA API supports icmpAccessType (PING, PING_TRACEROUTING, NONE) on application segments per the API docs, but neither `zpa_create_application_segment` nor `zpa_update_application_segment `expose it as a parameter, it is silently dropped, always defaulting to NONE.

No workaround exists via the MCP server. It is fairly common Customers want to be able to test apps post deployment cycle. Fix: Add icmp_access_type to both tool schemas, mapping to icmpAccessType in the API request body.
Upgrade to the latest version v0.11.0 where this issue has been fixed.
